# relay

> An open-source harness that turns one person's coding-agent subscriptions (Claude, Codex, Grok) into one system: GitHub issues as the task bus, self-hosted runners on your own machines, shared memory in Postgres, and an event feed of everything agents did. Credentials never leave the machine they were created on.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what it does, quick install, how to link model accounts
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents working in or installing this repo
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the design and the rules behind it

## Guides

- [Runners](docs/RUNNERS.md): registering a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner that holds your logins
- [Memory](docs/MEMORY.md): decisions, preferences, vendor guidance, and the MCP server
- [Feed](docs/FEED.md): event kinds, sources, and the ledger view

## Reference

- [Database schema](packages/core/src/db/migrations/001_init.sql): plain-SQL migrations, applied by `relay init`
- [Research: orchestration survey](docs/research/2026-09-23-orchestration-survey.md)
